title: getCampaign request
description: GET /v1/campaigns/{campaignId} - request. Campaign with its coverage.
$comment: Source: DISENO S5 (b) BackfillCampaign, (c) campaign/firm_progress AP-D3, (d) StartCampaignUseCase/PauseCampaignUseCase, (e) operator APIs, (h); PRD RF-014, RF-083, RNF-035, SLO-06; US-02.2.1. Audience: OPERATOR (operator console / role-restricted). Residency: REGIONAL (cell); firmId stays in the cell. Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: none (aggregates only).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).
